evals.prompt: Our average sales cycle ballooned from 45 to 90 days. Pipeline looks full but nothing closes. Diagnose.
evals.expected_output: Should treat velocity as a system problem. Should inspect stage exit criteria, zombie deals, multi-threading, MAPs, and pipeline deflation — not just 'coach reps harder.' Should propose concrete operating changes.
assertions: Frames velocity as a system problem
Inspects stage exit criteria or zombie deals
Addresses multi-threading or mutual action plans
Proposes concrete process fixes not pep talks
